failures.assertion: Keeps `--approval-mode default` (not `yolo`) and a bounded `timeout` on any command it proposes, and states the command was not run.
failures.evidence: The Gemini commands use "timeout --foreground --kill-after=10s 1800 ... --approval-mode default" and "timeout --kill-after=10s 300 ... --approval-mode default", and the output states "Not run. These are proposed commands only". However, the proposed `cd /work/api && gemini --list-sessions` has no `timeout` and no `--approval-mode default`.
